references.text: The Lord appears to Abram by the oaks of Moreh, which is a parallel to God's revelation to Abraham by the oaks of Mamre.
Abraham settles by the oaks of Mamre, the place where the Lord appears to him in Gen 18:1.
Abraham is described as living by the oaks of the Amorite Mamre, the same place where the Lord appears to him.
The Lord appears to Abram (וַיֵּרָא יְהוָה אֶל־אַבְרָם) – the closest preceding parallel to the revelation formula in Gen 18:1.
The Lord appears to Isaac (וַיֵּרָא אֵלָיו יְהוָה), with exactly the same revelation formula as in Gen 18:1.
The call to hospitality, for some have entertained angels without knowing it, refers directly to Abraham's reception of the three guests in Gen 18.
